chemical-dosing-tank-bunded-50l.shortDescription: 50L polyethylene chemical dosing tank for water treatment, chemical storage and dosing. Tank only; matching 50L bund sold separately.
chemical-dosing-tank-bunded-50l.description:
A **50L polyethylene chemical dosing tank** for water-treatment, chemical-storage and dosing applications. This is the **tank-only** product, making it the right page for buyers looking for a **50L chemical tank**, **plastic chemical storage tank** or compact **polyethylene dosing tank** without an included bund.

Manufactured from rotationally moulded linear low-density polyethylene (PE), the seamless tank is suited to compatible liquid chemical storage, mixing and dosing applications. A matching 50L Chemical Bund is available separately when secondary containment is required.

- 50L chemical tank capacity
- Polyethylene chemical storage tank construction
- 390 mm diameter × 460 mm overall height
- 150 mm top port
- Tank only - bund sold separately
- Suitable for compatible water-treatment and chemical-dosing applications
